1yzdsv7:169: AI-driven rapid layoffs also destroy the organization's learning capacity. Truly effective AI applications require continuous interaction between humans and AI systems—humans teach AI what "good enough" output looks like through feedback, and AI progressively takes over more tasks through iteration. This learning process requires a stable team structure and sufficient "buffer time." When teams are rapidly dismantled, the learning curve is forcibly interrupted, AI systems never reach optimal performance, and the organization loses the opportunity to learn from failure.
